description: This file contains mixin definitions for button styles in SCSS, providing reusable style patterns for button variants, outline variants, and size configurations.

methods.name: button-variant
methods.description: Defines a mixin for styling various button states and variants including hover, focus, active, and disabled, utilizing CSS custom properties.

methods.name: button-outline-variant
methods.description: Defines a mixin for styling outline-type button variants with different states.

methods.name: button-size
methods.description: Defines a mixin for setting button sizing parameters such as padding, font size, and border radius.
